name: Swetrix
description: Swetrix is a privacy-first, cookie-less web analytics platform with built-in error tracking and performance monitoring. Self-hosted via nginx reverse proxy with Node.js API and React frontend, backed by ClickHouse and Redis.

notes.text: The API also listens on 0.0.0.0:5005 and is reachable without nginx; firewall that port if the container is exposed.
Registration is disabled by default (DISABLE_REGISTRATION=true in /opt/swetrix/backend/.env). Set it to false to allow additional accounts.
Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse (/var/lib/clickhouse) and Redis; back them up before major updates.
